frequency_question: How often do major macroprudential capital buffer or capital requirement tightening initiatives successfully clear structural regulatory friction and reach final implementation within a designated window?
membership_rule: Includes formal Board of Governors proposals for capital requirement hikes (e.g., CCyB, stress capital buffer adjustments, Basel III endgame components) from 2010 to present. Excludes routine microprudential adjustments or monetary policy interest rate changes.

cases.name: Countercyclical Capital Buffer initial framework establishment
Basel III Endgame / Enhanced Capital Requirements proposal and subsequent major re-proposal/stalling friction

coverage_note: 4 major capital tightening initiatives identified in the post-Dodd-Frank era; 3 successfully finalized, 1 currently mired in structural/inter-agency friction.
known_gaps: Excludes minor technical amendments; focuses exclusively on capital buffer level changes and major structural capital rulemakings.
skeleton: Major regulatory tightening cycles requiring inter-agency consensus and overcoming institutional pushback.
multiplier: 3 hits out of 4 historical major rulemakings
validity_reason: The structural administrative procedures act (APA) requirements and Federal Reserve governance frameworks remain stable over this horizon.
